outcome: composite score of stillbirth, duration of pregnancy, birth weight, preeclampsia, and cesarean section
cohort: 12,129 pregnant women within 'the Born in Guangzhou Cohort Study' China who underwent a standard 75-g oral-glucose-tolerance-test (OGTT) between 22 and 28 gestational weeks
finding: Elevated fasting, 1 and 2-h glucose levels are associated with a range of adverse maternal-birth outcomes.
mod_finding: Elevated glucose levels were associated with a higher composite score, which included cesarean section as an outcome.
